nextStoryContext: US-003 must create .github/workflows/ci.yml with macos-latest, brew install tmux, bun install --frozen-lockfile, and bun run check:all. After ci.yml exists, add 'ci-parity' gate to the GATES manifest in check-all.ts. The three fixture files in test/fixtures/ (aligned, unknown-script, missing-gate) are already in place and used by check-ci-parity tests. The checkParity / checkParityFromFile exports from scripts/check-ci-parity.ts are importable by test/ci-workflow.test.ts (the test that validates the real ci.yml). The gate name for the parity gate should be 'ci-parity' and its cmd should be 'bun run check:ci-parity' or equivalent.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Named exports confirmed: load, loadAll, dump, schema constants. No default export in v4/v5. load() throws YAMLException on error. import { load } from 'js-yaml' is the correct forward-compatible form. Matches patterns.md js-yaml named import rule.
